notes.title: Teaser trailer released
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce that I have released a teaser trailer on July 23, 2024 (JST).

[previewyoutube=daaAw6dyBwE;full][/previewyoutube]

The Steam store page has also been updated to coincide with the release of the teaser trailer.

[h2]Development Status[/h2]

About three weeks have passed since my last news post. Development is progressing smoothly.

[list]
[*] Implemented dynamic sound reverb.
[*] Created the main 3D assets for housing and props.
[*] Created shaders to realize special graphic effects.
[/list]

I had some difficulties creating the 3D assets, but I managed to create the main assets. Next, I plan to start implementing in-game effects.

Please stay tuned for further updates.

notes.title: Development progress after the store page was released
notes.content:
[b]Translation Notice[/b]: The announcement will be available in English and Japanese. The game will be translated into various languages. The current store page is automatically translated, but I plan to translate it manually when the game is released.

[h2]Development progress[/h2]
I'm currently working hard on "Void Path". I have created several gameplay prototypes and the outline of the gameplay has been decided. The following list shows what I have done since the release of the Steam store page.

[list]
[*] I have introduced sound middleware to achieve a stereophonic sound.
[*] I have completed coding the foundation of the game system.
[*] I have established a workflow and pipeline for creating 3D assets.
[*] I have watched a lot of Japanese horror movies to get references for creepy atmosphere.
[*] I have played a lot of horror games to get references for gameplay.
[/list]

Please share "Void Path" with your friends and family as it will encourage me!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3KsJWcr.gif[/img]
